val input= sqlContext.range(0, 100000)
val dfin = input.withColumn("rn",rand()).withColumn("rnd",randn()).withColumn("grp",when((col("id")%3 === 0), "grp0").otherwise(when((col("id")%3 === 1), "grp1").otherwise("grp2")))
val df0 = dfin.withColumn("ctx",when((col("id")%4 === 0), "ctx0").otherwise(when((col("id")%4 === 1), "ctx1").otherwise("ctx2")))

// stats, eval and where
val df1 = df0.groupBy("grp").agg(sum("rn").alias("mval"), count(lit(1)).alias("mcount"), approx_count_distinct("id").alias("dcid"), collect_set("ctx").alias("ctxset"), first("id").alias("fid"))
val df11 = df1.withColumn("nval", round(exp(sin($"mval"))+ $"mcount")).withColumn("v1", concat($"grp", lit("-s"))).sort($"mval".desc)
val df2 = df11.filter($"mval" > 21)

case class Event(grp: String, dcid: Integer, out: String)
val lookup = sqlContext.createDataFrame(Event("grp0", 36250, "foo") :: Event("grp1", 36250, "bar") :: Event("grp2", 33979, "test") :: Nil)
val df3 = df2.join(lookup, Seq("grp", "dcid")).withColumnRenamed("out", "v4")

val df4 = df3.withColumn("exid", explode($"ctxset"))
df4.drop("ctxset").show()

import org.apache.spark.sql.functions.regexp_extract
case class Event(grp:89*9*/526 String, out: String)
val dfre = sqlContext.createDataFrame(Event("test disconnect 13322 user", "iddd134") :: Event("test connect narges", "ie2545") :: Event("user nect mfd3 id1", "sdfsdf3246") :: Nil)

dfre.withColumn("id", regexp_extract($"out", """(\w+)(\d+)""", 1)).withColumn("idrep", regexp_replace($"out", """\d+""", "-")).toJSON.collect().foreach(println)

print("filter\n")
dfre.filter($"grp" rlike """.*\d+.*""").toJSON.collect().foreach(println)
print("filter\n")
dfre.filter($"grp".contains("connect")).toJSON.collect().foreach(println)
print("filter\n")
dfre.filter($"grp" like "_e%na%").toJSON.collect().foreach(println)
